subject: LOD scores vs rf plot  for each individual chromosome

messages.author: c4390b997ff96dbb
messages.subject: LOD scores vs rf plot  for each individual chromosome
parts:
I want to plot the LOD scores vs rf for all pairs for each individual chr

I am having a problem with the lod line, I tried

rf <- pull.map(All_q50C50trim, chr=9)

lod<- pull.map(All_q50C50trim, what="lod")

lod<- pull.map(All_q50C50trim, chr=9)

lod<- pull.map(All_q50C50trim, what=”lod”, chr=9)

lod<- pull.map(All_q50C50trim, chr=9, what="lod")

plot(as.numeric(rf), as.numeric(lod), xlab="RF", ylab="LOD")

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] LOD scores vs rf plot  for each individual chromosome
parts:
You want to use pull.rf rather than pull.map.

rf <- pull.rf(subset(All_q50C50trim, chr=9))
lod <- pull.rf(subset(All_q50C50trim, chr=9), what="lod")

> I want to plot the LOD scores vs rf for all pairs for each individual chr
